name: 4-thioescaline
summary: 4-Thioescaline (4-TE), or thioescaline, also known as 3,5-dimethoxy-4-ethylthiophenethylamine, is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine and scaline families related to mescaline. It is the analogue of escaline in which the methoxy group at the 4 position has been replaced with a methylthio group. The drug is one of two possible thioescaline (TE) positional isomers, the other being 3-thioescaline (3-TE).

pharmacology.en: Like mescaline, it is thought to act mainly on the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor, the main target of classic psychedelics.
pharmacology.zh: 一般認為它和麥司卡林一樣，主要作用於血清素5-HT2A受體，也就是經典迷幻藥的主要作用目標。
pharmacology.zhHans: 一般认为它和麦司卡林一样，主要作用于血清素5-HT2A受体，也就是经典迷幻药的主要作用目标。

uses.en: It was described by Alexander Shulgin in his book PiHKAL and has rarely been used outside that work.
uses.zh: Alexander Shulgin在著作《PiHKAL》中描述過它，除此之外很少有人使用。
uses.zhHans: Alexander Shulgin在著作《PiHKAL》中描述过它，除此之外很少有人使用。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the psychedelic phenethylamines, can cause nausea, dilated pupils, a faster heartbeat, raised blood pressure, muscle tension, anxiety, confusion and frightening experiences. In people at risk, they can trigger lasting mental health problems such as psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的迷幻苯乙胺類藥物，可能引起噁心、瞳孔放大、心跳加快、血壓升高、肌肉緊繃、焦慮、意識混亂與驚恐的經驗。對本身有風險的人，可能誘發精神病等持久的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的迷幻苯乙胺类药物，可能引起恶心、瞳孔放大、心跳加快、血压升高、肌肉紧绷、焦虑、意识混乱与惊恐的经验。对本身有风险的人，可能诱发精神病等持久的心理健康问题。

fact.en: Mescaline, the parent of this family, was first isolated from the peyote cactus by the German chemist Arthur Heffter in 1897. 4-Thioescaline swaps the oxygen at the 4 position for sulphur.
fact.zh: 這個家族的源頭麥司卡林，是德國化學家Arthur Heffter於1897年從佩奧特仙人掌中首次分離出來的。4-硫代依斯卡林則把第4位上的氧換成了硫。
fact.zhHans: 这个家族的源头麦司卡林，是德国化学家Arthur Heffter于1897年从佩奥特仙人掌中首次分离出来的。4-硫代依斯卡林则把第4位上的氧换成了硫。
